title: ISO/IEC 42001 Artificial intelligence management system
content_policy: Clause and control identifiers with organization-authored summaries. Licensed standard text is not reproduced. Titles marked 'as referenced' come from the demonstration documents and are pending verification.

requirements.summary: Define the boundaries of the AI management system scope.
Maintain a documented AI policy approved by senior management.
Assign and communicate named AI governance roles and authorities.
Plan actions that address AI risks and opportunities.
Assess AI-specific risks (as referenced in the FinanceGuard portfolio).
Assess operational impact before deployment or change.
Monitor, measure and evaluate management-system performance.
Address nonconformities and improve continually.
Policy formally authorized (as referenced); also cited for verification and validation in the Contoso matrix.
Data quality evaluation (as referenced).
Documented, named AI roles and responsibilities (as referenced).
Clear lifecycle accountability for the AI system (as referenced).
Provenance of training and validation data (as referenced).
Impact assessment process (as referenced); also cited for user information and data handling.
Inform people they are interacting with AI (as referenced).
Logging, monitoring and AI incident management (as referenced).
Monitoring cadence (as referenced).
Intended and inappropriate uses documented (as referenced).
AI system impact assessment (as referenced).
Security of AI systems (as referenced).
Authorized use and transparency to users (as referenced).
